svg.title: Lean proof of SIC existence
svg.desc: 448 local Lean files supporting the two SIC existence results. 801 imports between these files; 446 selected forest edges. Each outer file is imported by the inner file connected to it in the selected tree. Colors group mathematical topics; radius in the wheel is for layout only.
